title: StochasticLocalHessianConvex.lean

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a C² convex function f on ℝᵈ with an attained minimum x⋆, ‖x₀−x⋆‖≤R, and f(x₀)−f(x⋆)≤Δ. Strong convexity is not required.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Oracle 0 returns g(x,ξ), with independent identically distributed seeds, E[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x), and E‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖²≤σ². Each sample counts as one call.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Oracle 1 returns a deterministic measurable linear operator H(x) satisfying ‖H(x)−∇²f(x)‖op≤δ uniformly in x. Symmetry is not explicitly required. Full operator evaluations are counted separately from gradient samples; no function-value oracle is supplied.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every x,y with ‖y−x‖≤ρ, ‖∇²f(y)−∇²f(x)‖op≤(M₀+M₁‖∇f(x)‖)‖y−x‖, where M₀,M₁≥0 and ρ>0. No global constant bound on the Hessian or its Lipschitz modulus is imposed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform additive gradient variance bound σ² with σ≥0; no bounded-noise or exponential-tail assumption is imposed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: biased_oracle
distinctive_assumptions.details: Hessian errors may be arbitrary deterministic errors bounded by δ≥0 in operator norm. No Hessian unbiasedness assumption is imposed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), with Euclidean vector norms and induced operator norms.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: All Params are public, including d,x₀,M₀,M₁,ρ,δ,σ,R,Δ,ε,β and the seed type. The objective and minimizer are hidden. R,Δ,ε>0 and 0<β<1. Oracle budgets are fixed separate call caps.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticLocalHessianConvex.lean: Params, Instance, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.valid; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace, Convergence

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable point-valued output x̂ satisfying f(x̂)−f(x⋆)≤ε on the success event; no last-iterate requirement is imposed.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: P(f(x̂)−f(x⋆)>ε)≤β, over the joint algorithm and oracle randomness, with 0<β<1.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines local gradient-dependent Hessian regularity, finite-variance stochastic gradients, uniformly inexact deterministic Hessians, and high-probability objective accuracy under separate fixed oracle budgets.

descriptionHtml:
Stochastic Convex Local Hessian Regularity

We consider minimizing a twice continuously differentiable convex function f:Rd→R, where d is a nonnegative integer. Its Hessian is locally Lipschitz with a bound depending on the gradient norm. A given point x0 has bounded distance and objective gap to a global minimizer x⋆. Two oracles return unbiased stochastic gradients with bounded variance using independent identically distributed samples, and deterministic uniformly accurate Hessian approximations. For ε>0 and β∈(0,1), the goal is a measurable output x¯ satisfying P{f(x¯)−f(x⋆)>ε}≤β, where P is the joint law of oracle and algorithm randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈Rdf(x). We use the Euclidean norm ∥⋅∥ and its induced operator norm ∥⋅∥op on linear maps from Rd to itself. The parameters satisfy M0,M1,δ,σ≥0,ρ,R,Δ,ε>0,β∈(0,1). The algorithm receives d, the measurable sample space Ω, x0∈Rd, and all the parameters M0,M1,ρ,δ,σ,R,Δ,ε,β.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Convexity and initialization). The function f belongs to C2(Rd) and satisfies, for every x,y∈Rd and t∈[0,1], f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y). There is a global minimizer x⋆∈Rd such that f(x⋆)≤f(x)for every x∈Rd,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R,f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ.

Assumption 2 (Local Hessian regularity). For every x,y∈Rd with ∥y−x∥≤ρ, ∥∇2f(y)−∇2f(x)∥op≤(M0+M1∥∇f(x)∥)∥y−x∥.

Assumption 3 (Stochastic gradients and approximate Hessians). There are a probability measure ν on Ω, a jointly measurable map g:Rd×Ω→Rd, and a measurable map H taking each point in Rd to a linear operator on Rd. For every x∈Rd, the random vector g(x,ξ) is Bochner integrable and ∥g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)∥2 is integrable under ξ∼ν, with Eξ∼ν[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x),Eξ∼ν[∥g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)∥2]≤σ2,∥H(x)−∇2f(x)∥op≤δ. The sample sequence (ξk)k≥0 consists of measurable, mutually independent random variables with common law ν, and is independent of the algorithm’s randomness. At the kth oracle call, a gradient query at x returns g(x,ξk), while a Hessian query at x returns the deterministic operator H(x).

Queries to either oracle may be made at any point of Rd. Gradient calls and Hessian calls have separately counted budgets. After the allotted calls, the output x¯∈Rd must be measurable and satisfy P{f(x¯)−f(x⋆)>ε}≤β.

import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.MeasurableSpace
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Constructions.BorelSpace.ContinuousLinearMap

namespace LongTails.Setups.StochasticLocalHessianConvex

open OracleTemplate MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

abbrev Point (d : ℕ) := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

structure Params where
  d : ℕ
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  x0 : Point d
  M₀ : ℝ
  M₁ : ℝ
  ρ : ℝ
  δ : ℝ
  σ : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  β : ℝ

attribute [instance] Params.measurableΩ

structure Instance (p : Params) where
  f : Point p.d → ℝ
  xstar : Point p.d

abbrev spec : Setup where
  numOracles := 2
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance := Instance
  Query p := Point p.d
  Reply p := Point p.d ⊕ (Point p.d →L[ℝ] Point p.d)
  Output p := Point p.d
  publicInput p := p
  valid p := 0 ≤ p.M₀ ∧ 0 ≤ p.M₁ ∧ 0 < p.ρ ∧ 0 ≤ p.δ ∧ 0 ≤ p.σ ∧
    0 < p.R ∧ 0 < p.Δ ∧ 0 < p.ε ∧ 0 < p.β ∧ p.β < 1
  admissible p I O :=
    ContDiff ℝ 2 I.f ∧ ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ I.f ∧
    IsMinOn I.f Set.univ I.xstar ∧ ‖p.x0 - I.xstar‖ ≤ p.R ∧
    I.f p.x0 - I.f I.xstar ≤ p.Δ ∧
    (∀ x y, ‖y - x‖ ≤ p.ρ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ (gradient I.f) y - fderiv ℝ (gradient I.f) x‖ ≤
        (p.M₀ + p.M₁ * ‖gradient I.f x‖) * ‖y - x‖) ∧
    ∃ (g : Point p.d → p.Ω → Point p.d)
      (H : Point p.d → Point p.d →L[ℝ] Point p.d)
      (p0 : ProbabilityMeasure p.Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → p.Ω)),
    StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID
      (fun k (ξ : ℕ → p.Ω) => ξ k) (p0 : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
    O = { Seed := fun _ => p.Ω
          law := P
          answer := fun _ (i, x) ω =>
            if i = 0 then Sum.inl (g x ω) else Sum.inr (H x) } ∧
    Measurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧ Measurable H ∧
    (∀ x, Integrable (g x) (p0 : Measure _)) ∧
    (∀ x, ∫ ω, g x ω ∂(p0 : Measure _) = gradient I.f x) ∧
    (∀ x, Integrable (fun ω => ‖g x ω - gradient I.f x‖ ^ 2) (p0 : Measure _)) ∧
    (∀ x, ∫ ω, ‖g x ω - gradient I.f x‖ ^ 2 ∂(p0 : Measure _) ≤ p.σ ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ x, ‖H x - fderiv ℝ (gradient I.f) x‖ ≤ p.δ)
  successful p I output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
    (P : Measure _) {ω | p.ε < I.f (output ω) - I.f I.xstar} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal p.β

end LongTails.Setups.StochasticLocalHessianConvex
